name: ai-local-hub
description: Native Rust MCP hub for AI clients, with a React UI and Tauri desktop shell

scripts.build: npm run build:rust && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.test:rust: node scripts/native-build.mjs --debug && node rust/runtime/tests/mcp-smoke.mjs && node rust/runtime/tests/omp-file-tools-smoke.mjs && node rust/runtime/tests/omp-search-tools-smoke.mjs && node rust/runtime/tests/omp-bash-tools-smoke.mjs && node rust/runtime/tests/omp-ast-tools-smoke.mjs && node rust/runtime/tests/omp-lsp-tools-smoke.mjs && node rust/runtime/tests/omp-lsp-real-server-smoke.mjs && node rust/runtime/tests/hardening-smoke.mjs && node rust/runtime/tests/manager-smoke.mjs && node scripts/test-cargo.mjs
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build && npm --prefix desktop run dev
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && npm --prefix desktop run build
scripts.build:dev: npm run build:rust:dev && npm --prefix web run build
